prompt:
A finished painted background for a 2D narrative adventure game: a single digital painting with visible, confident brushwork in the manner of traditional gouache and oil sketching, painterly edges, simplified shapes, rich atmospheric perspective and a limited dusk palette of deep blue, violet and teal with warm orange accents only at the horizon, in the lit window and in the lamps. The picture is designed for a slow camera move in depth, so it is built from clearly separated depth planes with clean, readable silhouettes: every object stands out from what lies behind it by a clear change of value and colour (no ink outlines), and there is no fog, mist or haze blurring the edges between near and far objects. Eye-level view from the quay, as if standing on it: the camera is about two metres above the paving and looks straight out to sea, the horizon is a straight level line at 40 % of the picture height from the top. Composition from near to far: the nearest things are two barrels, a stack of crates and a coil of rope standing on the quay at the lower right, a few metres from the viewer, clearly in front of the sea; the open paving of the quay fills the lower middle of the picture and stays completely free (game characters walk there later); the iron lantern on its wooden post stands on the quay at about 40 % of the picture width in the middle ground; the harbour-master's cottage stands on the quay in the left third, its front facing the viewer, a little behind the walking area; the wooden jetty reaches out into the water in the centre with the two boats moored beside it; farther away on the right a rocky headland with the lighthouse at about 80 % of the picture width; behind everything the calm open sea, distant islands at the horizon and the sky. Keep every object at least 6 % away from the picture edges: the frame will be cropped and moved. Effects that the game animates are not painted: the lighthouse lamp only as a small glowing spot without any beam, rays or halo, no smoke from the chimney, no birds, no lens flare, the lantern glass glows with only a very small soft glow around it. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not a postcard, not a cartoon with ink outlines, no heavy fog.
Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.
Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: landscape 3:2.
